plugins.name: fusion
plugins.description: Control Autodesk Fusion 360—search projects, open files, export STEP/STL/URDF, and run Python scripts inside Fusion.

plugins.name: kicad
plugins.description: Control the running KiCad PCB Editor—inspect and edit boards, load footprints and 3D models, and export designs.

plugins.name: robodocs
plugins.description: Live-fetched documentation skills for the robotics stack — HuggingFace LeRobot, the NVIDIA Physical-AI suite (Isaac Sim/Lab/ROS, GR00T, Cosmos, Warp, Omniverse, OpenUSD, NGC Catalog, Developer Forums), and the MuJoCo ecosystem (MJX, MJWarp, Menagerie, Playground, MPC, dm_control)

plugins.name: isaacsim
plugins.description: NVIDIA Isaac Sim setup and health for robotics workstations — detects existing installs (pip/binary/source), registers the omni.kit.mcp bridge, persistently enables the ROS 2 bridge, and installs the native Isaac Viewer streaming app on macOS

plugins.name: isaaclab
plugins.description: Isaac Lab setup, health, and project scaffolding — detects existing installs (pip venv or source, never assuming a venv name), scaffolds extension projects from the pinned template with omni.kit.mcp bridge launch support, and enforces the per-profile launch-guard rule
